title: 36 Hours in San Juan, Puerto Rico
abstract: Bar-hop in an old quarter, explore a street splashed with murals and fly kites on the lawn of a fortress in this Caribbean capital.

title: 36 Hours in Toronto
abstract: Savor the diversity of this lakefront city though its hidden bars, small-but-fascinating museums and restaurants with dishes like jerk chicken chow mein and Hong Kong-style French toast.

title: 36 Hours in Munich
abstract: Shedding its conservative reputation, the Bavarian capital is finding unusual ways to balance tradition and innovation.

title: 36 Hours on Maui
abstract: The beauty and hospitality of this Hawaiian island, still recovering from last year’s wildfires, remain as vibrant as ever.
